methods.label: Apply the operation rule
methods.explanation:
The rule cubes the first input and squares the second, so the order of the inputs matters. Applying it to each ordered pair gives
\[
2\heartsuit4=2^3\cdot4^2=8\cdot16=128
\]
and
\[
4\heartsuit2=4^3\cdot2^2=64\cdot4=256.
\]
The denominator is nonzero, so
\[
\frac{2\heartsuit4}{4\heartsuit2}
=\frac{128}{256}=\frac12.
\]
The answer is \(\tfrac12\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
